subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: After rebasing, should OpenClaw adopt this shared rollback contract, including retaining an accepted external plugin installation when the user returns to the channel picker?
rationale: Tests establish implementation behavior, but maintainers must approve the compatibility-sensitive boundary between reversible wizard state and durable plugin installation or authentication effects.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Resolve conflicts, audit every persistent-effect path, and land if focused tests and changed-surface checks pass on the resulting head.

options.title: Narrow Initial Landing
options.body: Land first-prompt Back navigation separately and defer retained-install or broader rollback semantics until their durable-state contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, audit every persistent-effect path, and land if focused tests and changed-surface checks pass on the resulting head.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository-wide CODEOWNERS signal makes this the best available independent approval route for a shared core/plugin compatibility decision.
